task.title: Idempotently append visitor messages and update consultation retention
task.input: M4 durable conversations/seq/outbox and read/read-cursor APIs.
task.output: POST /api/chat/conversations/[id]/messages and a reusable message-append service.
task.accept: 1) Caller/wiring point: real POST messages -> cookie-scope/OPEN checks -> row-locked seq/message/outbox/90-day deadline in one transaction. Same clientMessageId/payload returns the original id/seq with one notification; changed payload returns 409. closed/anonymized rejects; failed writes change nothing (E-18, E-33, E-90). 2) Drop the HTTP response after successful persistence, then retry the original UUID/payload and receive the same receipt. Only the initial commit advances 90 days; reads/notifications do not. Expired/revoked credentials or another person's id/email cannot read or write (E-37, E-78, E-86).
